# CANDIDATE: ROBUST_EDGE_CAPTURE

**Filed:** 2026-07-05
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The ROBUST_EDGE_CAPTURE candidate aims to improve the edge capture of the existing BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup by incorporating additional context filters and refining the trigger logic. The hypothesis is that by adding more specific conditions to the setup, we can increase the accuracy of the edge capture and reduce false positives.

## Mechanism

The ROBUST_EDGE_CAPTURE candidate adds the following context filters to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup:

* A minimum ribbon spread of 30 cents (Fast EMA to Slow EMA)
* A volume confirmation filter to ensure that the breakdown bar has higher volume than the preceding bar
* A VIX confirmation filter to ensure that the VIX is rising or already above 20 at the time of entry

The trigger logic remains the same as the original BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup, with the addition of a ribbon-flip-back exit condition.
